0022600117.text: The Detroit Pistons (2-0, 1st in the Central) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (2-0, 1st in the Atlantic) for the Pistons' third game of the season, and both teams are still unbeaten. Detroit won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, 4-0, including a 116-93 win in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026, and the two teams have not met yet this season. Pistons guard Ausar Thompson and forward Jalen Duren are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, with Thompson's reason undisclosed and Duren's listed as a thigh issue, while the 76ers are missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), LeBron James (back), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain).
